name: Abyssalis
storyline:
Welcome to the depths!
Something dark awakens in the abyss. An overwhelming purple magic is turning the ocean into a living nightmare.
As a mage of the Veneficus Order, only you possess the power to purify these waters and uncover the origin of this evil. Prepare for a one-way descent into the darkest depths.
You are the last hope. SAVE THE OCEAN!
summary: Descend through the ocean layers, purify marine life, and survive the abyss in this bullet hell roguelite. Face deadly bosses, choose powerful upgrades, and uncover the origin of the curse. Can you save the ocean before becoming fish food?
